r21-2-008.gate_key: future | B1.1 | mcq | 'Are you free this evening?' 'Sorry, ___ Anna at 6. We booked a table yesterday.' | I'm meeting

key.correct: I'm meeting

item.q: 'Are you free this evening?' 'Sorry, ___ Anna at 6. We booked a table yesterday.'
item.correct: I'm meeting
item.why: An arrangement made earlier, with a time: present continuous (*I'm meeting*). *I'll meet* is a decision made now; *I meet* is for timetables.

wrong_why.I'll meet: *will* is for a decision made now; this was arranged yesterday.

item.why_lv: Iepriekš norunāta lieta ar laiku: Present Continuous (*I'm meeting*). *I'll meet* ir lēmums runāšanas brīdī; *I meet* lieto sarakstiem un grafikiem.

wrong_why_lv.I'll meet: *will* lieto lēmumam šajā brīdī; šis tika norunāts vakar.
